academic_interpretation.what_does_this_mean: Data profiling audits the statistical validity, completeness, and hygiene of raw records prior to dimensional ETL and machine learning. In Smart Freight, identifying target leakage attributes (such as post-delivery timestamps) ensures the regression model learns genuine causal predictors of shipment duration rather than memorizing historical outcomes.
academic_interpretation.technical_moments: We compute central tendency (arithmetic mean, 50th percentile median), dispersion (standard deviation, interquartile range IQR = Q75 - Q25), and shape asymmetry via the Fisher-Pearson coefficient of skewness. High positive skew indicates long-tail outlier shipments that require robust tree partitioning.
